source: jdx/fnox v1.39.0 + packages/wasi-fnox/NNNN-*.patch (apply.sh); each patch maps to cert cases below
checklist: fnox --version → fnox 1.39.0; --help lists exec/get/set/proxy and no daemon, tui, mcp; provider add --help offers sealed
with /etc/fnox/config.toml (default_provider seven, type sealed) via FNOX_CONFIG_DIR: get, export and env print the stored placeholder; no device needed
discovery from a subdirectory of the project (cwd from PWD)

without a vault: set from a pipe, exec with a sealed secret and check --all fail closed (`not running in seven: /dev/sealed is missing` on kernels without the device; `ENOTCONN: no vault is connected` from 1.68.0 without the sealed hook)
set NAME value (a value on the command line) is refused for a sealed secret; --key-name is refused
age: set --provider age encrypts to the recipients (ciphertext in fnox.toml, no plaintext); get fails with exactly `age secrets aren't supported in seven yet (slicc-vault#2)`
sync and reencrypt refused with `not available in seven: the value would be in a program (use a header rule)`
fnox edit refused cleanly: non-zero status, not 134, "fnox edit is not available in seven: use fnox set", no panic or trap (homescoop#376)
proxy rules --json prints the [proxy] rules; proxy run -- printenv shows each rule's env name holding the placeholder and the secret's own name unset

proxy run with a 1password, a bitwarden, a vault and an infisical provider configured: their credentials (OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN, FNOX_OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN, BW_SESSION, FNOX_BW_SESSION, VAULT_TOKEN, FNOX_VAULT_NAMESPACE, INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET, FNOX_INFISICAL_TOKEN) don't reach the child, as upstream (homescoop#401)
exec with only plain secrets: the child gets the value, stderr warns that it was passed as a plain value; exec of a missing command exits 127
exec --shell-grants without a vault fails closed (same errors)

shell integration (homescoop#400): hook-env -s bash exits 0 with `export LVL=debug` and the session, no panic or 134 trap; activate bash names /usr/bin/fnox, not a bare fnox its fnox() wrapper would call recursively; in bash, eval "$(fnox activate bash)" loads the secret at the hook, drops it outside the project, and fnox deactivate unsets it; an as_file secret is refused (no file in seven): hook-env skips it with the exec message, get fails with it
test/sealed.mjs (KS-2, vault double): set from a pipe → seal {name, value} → placeholder stored, value not in fnox.toml, stdout, stderr or /proc/<pid>/cmdline

test/sealed.mjs (KS-2, vault double): set on a terminal → request {kind: value} → status polled → placeholder stored; ^C sends cancel and exits 130; ^C during a 10 s machine wait cancels after the reply
test/sealed.mjs (KS-2, vault double): check → placeholder {name}: removed records and unknown placeholders are errors, inert records warnings

test/sealed.mjs case 11 (KS-8): exec under an { argv } grant → materialize {names, path /usr/bin/bash, argv (argv[0] = path), cwd}, no interpreter claim → consume stamped by the child (ppid = the asker) → the child holds the value (sha256), real:false names keep placeholders, the child's echo is scrubbed back to the placeholder, no value on stdout/stderr; a file the child writes holds the value (documented residual)

test/sealed.mjs cases 12–13 (KS-8, exposure): the child's /proc cmdline has no value; no /proc/<pid>/environ; its own children inherit the value with output still scrubbed; another user (users 'enforce') can't see the process in /proc; a used or forged SLICC_SEALED_TICKET fails the exec with 126 and reveals nothing

bios real setup (B18's seven row, slicc-bios #355): /etc/fnox/config.toml root-owned: a cone reads and resolves it, its writes fail with EACCES, sudo succeeds through the approval, no secret in any cone-readable file

test/sealed.mjs case 14 (KS-8): exec --shell-grants -- /bin/bash -c CMD → materialize {shellGrants: true, path, argv, cwd} with no names → the shell = true secret's placeholder via `placeholder {name}` → real in the bash; the config's own sealed secrets keep placeholders; output scrubbed

test/sealed.mjs case 15 (KS-8, interpreter chain): fnox never claims `interpreter`; an npm-style `#!/usr/bin/env bash` script is reported as /usr/bin/bash; under an { argv } grant it gets the value when trusted (root-owned, 0755, root-owned dirs), is refused when untrusted (world-writable dir), and is refused under exec = true

patches.0001-build-gate-non-WASI-dependencies-by: the build: wasm32-wasip1 links at all (no cloud SDKs, reqwest, keyring, TUI)
patches.0002-providers-build-only-age-and-plain-: age set encrypts; provider types outside the allowlist fail when used; proxy run removes a configured disabled provider's env_dependencies() from the child (NEGATIVE.md: 1.39.0-2 hands FNOX_OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN through)
patches.0003-cli-compile-out-modules-that-cannot: --help lists no daemon, tui or mcp
patches.0004-wasi-take-the-working-directory-and: get from a subdirectory of the project (cwd from PWD)
patches.0005-wasi-spawn-fnox-exec-children-throu: plain exec: the child runs and gets the value
patches.0006-providers-add-the-sealed-provider-f: get/export print the stored placeholder; the missing-device error; test/sealed.mjs: seal, rotation, placeholder {name}, the caller stamp; provider add --help offers sealed
patches.0007-set-seal-piped-values-and-ask-seven: set refuses argv values and --key-name; test/sealed.mjs: seal from a pipe, request/status/cancel on a terminal, EAGAIN
patches.0008-exec-let-seven-s-kernel-hand-sealed: exec with a sealed secret needs the device; missing command → 127; plain warning; test/sealed.mjs cases 9, 11–13, 15: materialize, the values in the child, exposure, failed tickets, interpreter chain
patches.0009-proxy-rules-json-and-proxy-run-with: proxy rules --json; proxy run gives the placeholder and scrubs the secret's name
patches.0010-seven-refuse-what-would-put-a-value: sync/reencrypt refused; age get fails with slicc-vault#2; test/sealed.mjs: check --all on inert, removed, rotated and missing records
patches.0011-wasi-allow-the-lints-that-code-comp: lint-only: the WASI build has no warnings (no runtime case)
patches.0012-exec-shell-grants-and-run-the-child: exec --shell-grants without the device fails; test/sealed.mjs cases 9 and 14 (NEGATIVE.md: without 0012, case 9 fails)
patches.0013-set-detect-a-terminal-on-WASI-refus: test/sealed.mjs cases 6–8: set on a terminal reaches the vault dialog (request/status/cancel); empty stdin refused before any seal (NEGATIVE.md: without 0013, case 6 fails)
patches.0014-edit-refuse-fnox-edit-on-WASI-inste: checklist: fnox edit fails with "fnox edit is not available in seven: use fnox set", not the 134 trap (NEGATIVE.md: 1.39.0-1 traps)
patches.0015-hook-env-and-activate-the-shell-int: checklist: hook-env exits 0 with the exports (NEGATIVE.md: 1.39.0-3 traps with 134, "no pids on this platform"); activate names /usr/bin/fnox and works in bash; as_file refused in hook-env and get

reproducible: build.sh sets SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH to the v1.39.0 tag's commit time (recipe source.epoch), so rust-embed's per-file times for age's i18n files no longer carry the machine's crate-unpack time (homescoop#364); two CI runs of the same head give the same fnox.wasm and package.tgz sha256
